nodes.description: Constant 2**256-1 used to decide whether the allowance must be decremented in transferFrom.
Public mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; written by the constructor, transfer and transferFrom, read by balanceOf.
Public nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 allowance; written by approve and transferFrom, read by allowance.
Public total token supply, initialized in the constructor.
Public token display name, set in the constructor.
Public number of decimals, set in the constructor.
Public token symbol, set in the constructor.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and minter in the constructor.
Constructor: grants 50000000000000 tokens to msg.sender and sets totalSupply, name, decimals and symbol.
Public transfer: requires balances[msg.sender] >= _value, debits sender, credits recipient, emits Transfer.
Public transferFrom: reads allowance, requires balance and allowance, moves tokens and decrements the allowance unless it is MAX_UINT256.
Public view returning balances[_owner].
Public approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Public view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer, used in the balance check and in the unchecked debit/credit arithmetic.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, used for the balance check and the debit.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom, used for the credit.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, used in the require check, credit, debit and allowance decrement.
Address parameter of balanceOf used as mapping key.
Spender address parameter of approve used as mapping key.
Allowance amount parameter of approve written into allowed.
Owner address parameter of allowance view.
Spender address parameter of allowance view.
Local cache of allowed[_from][msg.sender] used in the require check and in the allowance decrement.
Unchecked arithmetic balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer (underflow possible on Solidity 0.4.x).
Unchecked arithmetic balances[_to] += _value in transfer (overflow possible).
Unchecked arithmetic balances[_to] += _value in transferFrom (overflow possible).
Unchecked arithmetic balances[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (underflow possible).
Unchecked arithmetic allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom (underflow possible).

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the initial balance and totalSupply to the caller address msg.sender.
transfer authorizes and debits balances[msg.sender], which is fully caller-controlled.
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] and debits the spender allowance based on the caller identity.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], keyed by the caller-controlled address.
_to parameter flows into the transfer function body as the credit key.
_value parameter flows into the transfer function body for the require check and arithmetic.
_from parameter flows into the transferFrom function body for the balance check and debit key.
_to parameter flows into the transferFrom function body as the credit key.
_value parameter flows into the transferFrom function body for checks and arithmetic.
_owner parameter is used as the balances mapping key in balanceOf.
_spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
_value parameter is written into allowed in approve.
_owner parameter is used as the outer allowance mapping key.
_spender parameter is used as the inner allowance mapping key.
_value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] with no checked arithmetic.
_value is added to balances[_to] with no checked arithmetic.
_to selects the credited balance slot in transfer.
_value is added to balances[_to] in transferFrom with no checked arithmetic.
_to selects the credited balance slot in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from balances[_from] in transferFrom with no checked arithmetic.
_from selects the debited balance slot in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from the stored allowance with no checked arithmetic.
The local allowance variable is read from the allowed mapping.
The cached allowance value is decremented by _value without overflow protection.
